name: Blasebalg
prior: Free-reed physics models are academic, real-time but not products: Millot & Baumann minimal free-reed model with real-time numerical scheme [VS: arxiv.org/pdf/2401.01606]; Puranik & Scavone, physical model of the hand harmonium with bellows pressure as control + source-filter enclosure (POMA 2022) and a real-time Pure Data signal model played from MIDI (DAFx 2023 paper 47) [VS: pubs.aip.org/asa/poma/article/49/1/035015; dafx.de/paper-archive/2023/DAFx23_paper_47.pdf]; clamped-bar reed model, more harmonics at higher pressure (Forum Acusticum 2023) [VS: dael.euracoustics.org fa2023/000853]; accordion pitch bending explained by vent-hole pressure loss (FA 2026) [VS: dael.euracoustics.org fa2026/000418]; Hikichi & Osaka sho time-domain simulation 2001 [VS: journals.e-palli.com review]. Products: NUSofting Peti SA (hybrid FM/PM harmonium+accordion, bellows air noise, no reed ODE) [VS: nusofting.net/plugins/peti_sa; kvraudio]; Mokafix Harmoniac (old free 'physical model reed' harmonica, Windows) [VS: plugins4free.com/plugin/1525]; Syntheway Harmodion (additive). Harmonium/accordion/sho apps are sampled [VS: apps.apple.com Harmonium - Real Sounds]. Not found: any touch instrument with pressure threshold, speaking transient and overpressure choke on one axis, or bellows-shake from tilt/Puls. In Myzel: Hauch is filtered noise, no reed anywhere.
costNotes: Reed: 2nd-order ODE with 2 semi-implicit substeps + sqrt flow + chamber integrator ~20-25 ns/sample = 0.17-0.2 units; node 0.06 + 3-4 k-rate params 0.1 [R: webaudio.md s4]; wind noise in-worklet (table) 0.02. Body: the spec'd IIRFilterNode order 20 is ONE native node (~0.03 + 40 double MACs ~0.1) [R s7], so 0.12 is plausible, but see failure modes: it should be replaced by 3-4 peaking biquads (0.06 each = 0.2) or 8 worklet resonators (0.03 each = 0.25). L1 ~0.55 (idea 0.45). L3: second reed +0.2, ConvolverNode with a 120 ms IR per voice is unmeasured [R s7 'cheap fixed bodies', A: 0.3-0.5 per voice stereo] -> 1.1-1.3; measure before committing (bench item listed in engineer.md s10).
soundHeld: Held is the natural home: a drone that breathes with pressure (Hoehe/tilt) - below the Hopf threshold only wind, then the speaking dip, then tone, then choke. The risk is the middle 60% of the axis: a free reed's flow pulse spectrum is a bright pulse train through a fixed wooden body, i.e. organ/harmonium sawtooth - pleasant but close to 'static synth reed'. What makes it distinctive is only the dynamics: pressure -> level AND pitch flattening AND harmonic growth together (physics), plus the 30% pressure modulation under Bebung. Whether threshold and choke emerge from the ODE without the explicit x_0 = kappa*dp term is the idea's own open point (A) - with the term they are guaranteed; keep it. Sho cluster at L3 (two reeds) is a good ambient colour but two detuned reeds through one body beat like a musette; fine.
soundBurst: Weak as a hit: a free reed needs 20-60 ms to speak (the Ansprache dip), so a short Puls gate gives a huff with a half-formed tone - which IS bellows shake and is musical at 1/8 and 1/16 with gate >= 60 ms, but at gate 20-30 ms it is just noise + click, far from Membran/Tropfen in impact. Pressure pulse via gate (0->p->0) with the reed state kept across hits helps (reed already moving -> instant speak), so keep the voice alive across a Puls lane instead of restarting the ODE per hit.
failureModes: IIRFilterNode order 20 with 10 modes around 180-460 Hz at 48 kHz: the direct-form polynomial of 10 low-frequency pole pairs is ill-conditioned (poles at angle 0.02-0.06 rad, radius ~0.998); Blink/WebKit do not check stability [R s7]; pre-checking pole radius does not fix coefficient quantisation of the expanded polynomial. Use <= 3 biquads or in-worklet resonators

Reed ODE at f > 1 kHz: symplectic/semi-implicit Euler is stable up to ~15 kHz but warps the pitch; precompute the frequency correction or use an exact rotation for the linear part and add the force explicitly
Flow sqrt|dp| with sign at dp ~ 0 chatters; regularise sqrt(dp^2 + e^2)
Choke zone 0.9-1.0 on a 0-1 finger axis is 10% of the screen: easy to hit by accident under Gestik tilt offsets; add hysteresis and make the choke a slow collapse, not a cut
Mid-axis sound is close to a sawtooth organ -> relies on dynamics and body; without L3 convolver the wooden box is 3-4 peaks
Puls hits need >= 60 ms gates to speak; shorter = huff; keep reed state across hits
ConvolverNode per voice at L3 unmeasured; could push L3 to 1.5+
verdict: Rare: free-reed physics with bellows pressure exists in academic real-time models (Millot & Baumann, Puranik & Scavone's Pd harmonium) and products are hybrid-FM (Peti SA) or sampled; no touch instrument puts threshold, speaking dip and choke on one axis. Feasible as a worklet at about 0.55 units (1.2 at level 3 if the per-voice convolver measures well). The engineering flaw is the order-20 IIRFilterNode body: ten clustered low-frequency poles in one direct-form polynomial is numerically unsafe in Web Audio - use a few biquads or in-worklet resonators. Held drones breathe convincingly; Puls hits are huffs unless gates stay above 60 ms and the reed state survives between hits. Worth building, with the body redesigned.
